label: D1/GO: high after unrewarded trials (esp. S1 unrewarded, a1), low after S2 rewarded
terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == S2)
explanation: Raw reset gate r40 is driven, beyond timing (D2 near 0.93, D1 lowest and falling across the episode), by the previous trial outcome, all observed. At D1 it rises after unrewarded trials, most after reaching S1 unrewarded (+0.16) and after choosing a1 (+0.11); it drops after rewarded trials, most after S2 rewarded (-0.07 - 0.14). So the largest value is after a1 S1 u, the smallest after a2 S2 r. At GO the same effect is weaker: lower after reward (more so after S2 rewarded), higher after a2 unrewarded. D2 has essentially no residual. Trial-before reward added little (+0.015 dev R2). Seven observed terms: test R2 beyond timing 0.77 (all-cue ceiling 0.83, last-trial table 0.75).

issues: The GO claim is underspecified. GO is raised after ANY unrewarded trial, not only after a2 unrewarded: profile residuals are GO a1 S1 u +0.050 and a1 S2 u +0.050, against a2 u +0.095. Misses on the original terms show this as the largest systematic under-prediction (GO after a1 S2 u +0.037, GO after a1 S1 u +0.036). Splitting the GO term into a general unrewarded term (+0.055) and an a2 term (+0.032) raises test R^2 from 0.773 to 0.793 and removes those errors.

'Drops after rewarded trials' at D1 has an exception. D1 after a1 S1 r has a positive residual (+0.062), because the a1 and S1 effects outweigh the reward effect. The terms capture this additively, but the wording overgeneralises.

Some small structured errors remain: D1 after a1 S2 r is over-predicted (-0.037 to -0.039), and D1 on the episode's first trial ('?' previous trial) is under-predicted (+0.026 to +0.029). Both are minor.

The trial-before reward adds little (test 0.773 -> 0.778 with a D1 tv('reward',-2)==0 term), which agrees with the claim. The scores check out: test 0.773 against an all-observed ceiling of 0.80 and an all-cue ceiling of 0.83. No future variables are used.
